latest.title: Interior Curvature Estimates for the Graphical Scalar Curvature Equation in All Dimensions
latest.abstract: We resolve the long-standing problem of establishing interior \(C^2\) estimates for admissible solutions of the graphical scalar curvature equation in every dimension \(n\ge 3\). More precisely, we prove interior curvature estimates for admissible solutions to the constant graphical scalar curvature equation. The proof combines Jacobi inequalities with a two-surface maximum principle and a two-surface Pogorelov estimate.
latest.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
latest.workSummary: 对任意 n≥3、完整 Γ2 可容许分支上的常图形标量曲率方程，建立仅依赖维数及高度/斜率界的内部曲率估计。
latest.breakthrough: 用几何距离替代同底点竖直差，克服切空间与法向不匹配，使高维无额外半凸性假设的定量 C2 估计成为可能。
latest.limitations: 本轮核对的是光滑图形、常右端方程与 C1 先验控制；非恒定右端或一般弱解推广不应自动推断。关键两点估计仍待独立审查。
latest.aiEvidence: 作者披露在统一分离和两曲面 Pogorelov 论证发展中使用 ChatGPT 测试比较/截断函数、试算并寻找候选不等式反例；最终论证经作者检查与重写。
latest.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.02581v1 — Declaration on the use of artificial intelligence
latest.priorityReason: 针对长期核心估计问题给出跨维数结果，方法可能影响更多全非线性几何 PDE；已核对主定理、障碍分析与证明终结。
